# Portfolio repository instructions

This repository hosts the static GitHub Pages site at `https://alanthssss.github.io/`.

- Keep the site deployable directly from the repository root without a server, database, secrets, or a required build step.
- Use semantic HTML, responsive CSS, accessible interaction states, and progressive enhancement.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and maintain good contrast in both light and dark color schemes.
- Keep all portfolio navigation, content, project descriptions, accessibility text, and portfolio documentation available in equivalent Simplified Chinese and English. Language controls must be accessible, update the document language, and preserve a complete no-JavaScript experience.
- Present pinned projects as concise resume-style project experiences with evidence-backed summaries and bullets, not as raw metadata snapshots or generic repository cards.
- Project facts must come from the pinned-project metadata and README excerpts supplied in the task or from files in this repository. Never fabricate biography, roles, dates, employers, team sizes, usage figures, outcomes, or project capabilities; omit unsupported fields.
- Keep repository URLs usable without JavaScript.
- Do not add analytics, trackers, contact forms, generated lockfiles, or large binary assets.
- Before finishing, check internal links and review the page at narrow and wide viewport sizes.
